office_does: A Mason County PUD No. 1 commissioner sits on the three-member elected board that sets policy, budgets and the strategic plan for the electric and water utility based in Potlatch, for a six-year term; the whole PUD votes.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Ron Gold, in his third term representing District 2 (Skokomish Valley and Potlatch), is the only candidate and submitted no statement.

candidates.summary: Mason County PUD No. 1 commissioner for District 2 in his third term; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District 2 commissioner for the 2021-2026 term, his third [S2]
